# ADO604: always-runs-on-cancel

always() also runs when the run is canceled.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Conditions |
| **Default severity** | info |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | each original source file, before template expansion |

## Description

always() evaluates to true even if the run is canceled. succeededOrFailed() and not(canceled()) don't. Not reported when the complete condition is provably false on cancellation, or for publish/upload steps, where running on cancellation is usually intended.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
condition: always()
```

Instead:

```yaml
condition: succeededOrFailed()
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO604: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO604` or `--enable ADO604`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO604
```
